name: Phone on a visor bracket, no lenses (single full-screen view)
notes: The phone is strapped on top of the head or to a cap/visor with the screen tilted toward the eyes; the back camera looks ahead and slightly down. The patient reads the screen like a normal display, so no stereo split and no barrel distortion. The camera image keeps its true aspect and is never stretched; with rotation_fit FIT the whole camera frame stays visible while Mode B tilts it about the screen centre (the picture shrinks a little at large rolls instead of losing its corners). The plumb line and horizon are gravity-locked. Set rotation_fit to CROP to fill the screen and accept grey corners instead.
